method: Manual comparison of five rendered frames per preset and full MP4 decode

decisions.observation: The whole composition is horizontally reversed: the sun occupies the left side, and the frame rocks in the opposite visual direction from rhythm swing. The mirrored geography remains visible in both late motion frames, not merely a changed speed.
The late frames reduce the scene to broad warm amber and yellow blocks, then brighten in a distinct beat; this differs from full-color brightness flicker and black-and-white contour strobe.
